phase_boundary: After 298 of 300 clean RAG endpoints were valid; before clean eligibility, poison generation, Stage 5 calls, or any held-out accuracy evaluation.

triggers.observation: All three retained responses were valid JSON containing only question_index 0; the other nine requested question entries were omitted.
All LLM contracts passed, but a raw URL survived field-level masking and the normalized artifact correctly failed closed.

changes.rule: When an answer array contains valid, unique in-range entries but omits requested indices, retain each omitted index with status=none, answer=null, and selected_rank=null. Extra, duplicate, malformed, or out-of-range entries remain errors.
changes.why_conservative: No factual content or evidence attribution is invented.

changes.rule: Apply the existing https? URL replacement recursively to the complete judgment immediately before strict validation, including a bare URL prefix created exactly at a text-truncation boundary; retain the post-mask no-URL assertion.
changes.why_conservative: This enforces the already-frozen neutral-source URL firewall and does not alter labels or factual text other than source addresses.

scope: The rules are model-agnostic and apply to all subsequent clean and attacked endpoints. Previously stored valid immutable endpoints remain unchanged.
prohibited_changes: Do not synthesize an answer for an omitted question.
Do not parse malformed or duplicate answer entries.
Do not expose source URLs to downstream workflows.
Do not change retrieval, verdict prompts, attack setup, gates, or claim scope.
